cases.title: A small, tested, in-boundary change passes
A pagination loop silently drops the last item

files.src/paging.py:
def page(items, size):
    return [items[i:i + size] for i in range(0, len(items) - 1, size)]

findings: High: range stops at len(items) - 1, so the last item is dropped (src/paging.py:2) - use range(0, len(items), size)
Medium: the test asserts the buggy output instead of the intended behavior (tests/test_paging.py:2)

cases.title: Review in the implementer's own context cannot be independent

input.description: The implementer asks the same session, with edit access, to review its own diff and call it independent.

findings: Blocked: review would run in the implementer's own context with edit access, so it cannot be independent - dispatch a separate read-only reviewer
